name: Mads Villadsen
text: Creative playmaker with excellent vision and precise through passes.

name: Luca Ferrante
text: Clinical finisher, strong in the air, scores most goals from crosses.

name: Jonas Krogh
text: Tall and physical centre back, dominant in duels and set pieces.

name: Rafael Duarte
text: Technical dribbler who creates chances with quick feints and clever passing.

name: Emil Brandt
text: Reliable shot stopper, good at distribution with long accurate throws.

name: Oskar Lind
text: Fast winger who beats defenders on the outside and delivers dangerous crosses.

name: Tomas Reyes
text: Hard-working defensive midfielder who wins the ball back and breaks up play.

name: Nikolaj Sand
text: Pacey forward who runs in behind the defence and finishes with calm one-on-ones.

name: Viktor Hald
text: Ball-playing full back who overlaps constantly and delivers accurate crosses.

name: Marco Bellini
text: Deep-lying playmaker who controls tempo and switches play with long diagonal passes.
